open_points.subject: create_viewer
open_points.text: create_viewer: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through insert_viewer of the viewer_access repository of that transaction, a ViewerAccessRepository.
open_points.other_text: create_viewer: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the VIEWER_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction as action, the VIEWER member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the viewer_id of the new viewer as entity_id and None as project_id.
open_points.question: Must the new dependency note be limited to viewer-record persistence, or must the required audit write also go through insert_viewer?

open_points.subject: grant_viewer_project
open_points.text: grant_viewer_project: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_viewer of the viewer_access repository of that transaction, a ViewerAccessRepository, and through its get_viewer_grant and its insert_viewer_grant.
open_points.other_text: grant_viewer_project: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST authorize access management with the imported authorize_access_management, validate the same active Registry UUID with validate_project_reference before the transaction, reject an existing active pair, and append an audit with the GRANT_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction atomically.
open_points.question: Must the new dependency note be restricted to viewer-repository reads and writes, or must the required Registry validation read and audit write use only the listed ViewerAccessRepository operations?

open_points.subject: grant_viewer_project
open_points.text: grant_viewer_project: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_viewer of the viewer_access repository of that transaction, a ViewerAccessRepository, and through its get_viewer_grant and its insert_viewer_grant.
open_points.other_text: grant_viewer_project: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the GRANT_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction as action, the VIEWER_GRANT member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the grant_id of the new grant as entity_id and the validated project_id as project_id.
open_points.question: Must the new dependency note exclude audit writes from “each read and write,” or must the required append_audit write be replaced by one of the listed viewer-repository operations?

open_points.subject: issue_viewer_access
open_points.text: issue_viewer_access: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_viewer of the viewer_access repository of that transaction, a ViewerAccessRepository, and through its insert_viewer_credential, its list_viewer_credentials and its update_viewer_credentials.
open_points.other_text: issue_viewer_access: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the VIEWER_CREDENTIAL_ISSUE member of = models.AuditAction as action, the VIEWER_CREDENTIAL member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the credential_id of the new credential as entity_id and None as project_id.
open_points.question: Must the new dependency note exclude audit writes from “each read and write,” or must the required append_audit write use one of the listed ViewerAccessRepository operations?

open_points.subject: issue_viewer_access
open_points.text: issue_viewer_access: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_viewer of the viewer_access repository of that transaction, a ViewerAccessRepository, and through its insert_viewer_credential, its list_viewer_credentials and its update_viewer_credentials.
open_points.other_text: issue_viewer_access: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST leave every record it reads unmodified: repository values are frozen instances, so it never assigns to one of their fields. It MUST hand the repository replacements and leave the values it read untouched: each prior credential it revokes becomes a replacement built with the imported revise_viewer_access_credential from the one utc_now instant as revoked_at and the authorized administrator context, the list of those replacements is what reaches the repository, and the active sessions of the viewer are revoked through _revoke_viewer_sessions, which replaces each with revise_viewer_session, with the same instant.
open_points.question: Must session reads and writes performed through _revoke_viewer_sessions be added to the allowed dependency route, or must the required session revocation be removed?

open_points.subject: revoke_viewer
open_points.text: revoke_viewer: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_viewer of the viewer_access repository of that transaction, a ViewerAccessRepository, and through its list_viewer_credentials, its update_viewer and its update_viewer_credentials.
open_points.other_text: revoke_viewer: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the VIEWER_REVOKE member of = models.AuditAction as action, the VIEWER member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the revoked viewer_id as entity_id and None as project_id.
open_points.question: Must the new dependency note exclude audit writes from “each read and write,” or must the required append_audit write use one of the listed ViewerAccessRepository operations?

open_points.subject: revoke_viewer
open_points.text: revoke_viewer: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_viewer of the viewer_access repository of that transaction, a ViewerAccessRepository, and through its list_viewer_credentials, its update_viewer and its update_viewer_credentials.
open_points.other_text: revoke_viewer: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST leave every record it reads unmodified: repository values are frozen instances, so it never assigns to one of their fields. It MUST hand the repository replacements and leave the values it read untouched: the revoked viewer built with the imported revise_client_viewer, every credential of the viewer not already revoked built with the imported revise_viewer_access_credential, and every session revoked through _revoke_viewer_sessions, which replaces each with revise_viewer_session. Each of those builders receives the one utc_now instant as revoked_at, and the viewer and credential builders also receive the authorized administrator context; the whole revocation cascade commits in one transaction or not at all.
open_points.question: Must session reads and writes performed through _revoke_viewer_sessions be added to the allowed dependency route, or must the required session revocation be removed?

open_points.subject: revoke_viewer_access
open_points.text: revoke_viewer_access: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_viewer_credential and update_viewer_credentials of the viewer_access repository of that transaction, a ViewerAccessRepository.
open_points.other_text: revoke_viewer_access: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST append exactly one success audit with the imported append_audit into the audit repository of that transaction, built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent from the authorized administrator context, the VIEWER_CREDENTIAL_REVOKE member of = models.AuditAction as action, the VIEWER_CREDENTIAL member of = models.AuditEntityKind as entity_kind, the revoked credential_id as entity_id and None as project_id.
open_points.question: Must the new dependency note exclude audit writes from “each read and write,” or must the required append_audit write use one of the two listed ViewerAccessRepository operations?

open_points.subject: revoke_viewer_access
open_points.text: revoke_viewer_access: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make each read and write its other notes call for through get_viewer_credential and update_viewer_credentials of the viewer_access repository of that transaction, a ViewerAccessRepository.
open_points.other_text: revoke_viewer_access: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST leave every record it reads unmodified: repository values are frozen instances, so it never assigns to one of their fields. It MUST hand the repository replacements and leave the values it read untouched: the addressed credential becomes a replacement built with the imported revise_viewer_access_credential from the one utc_now instant as revoked_at and the authorized administrator context, and every session of that viewer is revoked through _revoke_viewer_sessions, which replaces each with revise_viewer_session, with the same instant, so revoking a credential also ends the sessions it authorised.
open_points.question: Must session reads and writes performed through _revoke_viewer_sessions be added to the allowed dependency route, or must the required revocation of every viewer session be removed?
